title: Kissed by Heat Filipino Oysters Stew
description: A rich and savory Filipino-inspired stew featuring succulent oysters, all simmered in a flavorful broth of coconut milk and spices. This dish is perfect for a cozy night in, especially during colder months.
instructions: Rinse the oysters under cold running water and scrub them clean, discarding any broken shells.
Heat the coconut oil in a dolsot-stone-bowl over medium heat.
Saute the onions and garlic until softened, stirring occasionally.
Grate the ginger and saute for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish sauce and stir to combine, allowing the flavors to meld.
Add the oysters to the bowl and simmer for 5 minutes, or until they begin to open.
Season with salt, black pepper, and coriander seeds to taste.
Cover the bowl with a sizzling stone and let it rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve the stew immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Be careful when handling the sizzling stone.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
